title: Expedition 33 Act 1 Walkthrough - Complete Guide
description: Detailed Act 1 walkthrough for Expedition 33 covering Spring Meadows through Stone Wave Cliffs with all bosses, items, side content, and collectibles.

sections.title: Spring Meadows
sections.content:
Spring Meadows is your first full dungeon after the Prologue, with a recommended level of 3-5. This verdant area introduces you to Expedition 33's core exploration and combat loop.

Main Path

  • Progress through the meadow fighting standard enemies to build AP familiarity
  • Defeat the Eveque (Level 3 Required Boss) — a straightforward fight introducing boss mechanics
  • Find and defeat the Spring Meadows Mime (Level 3 Optional) for cosmetic rewards

Optional Boss: Chromatic Lancelier (Level 5)

Your first Chromatic encounter. These upgraded enemies hit significantly harder than standard foes. If you struggle, return later — this is the easiest boss for the "Professional" trophy (defeat without taking damage) when you're overleveled.

Side Quest: Jar's Light

Find Jar in the meadow area and complete their request. Defeating the Jar boss (Level 5 Optional) completes this questline and rewards useful early-game equipment.

Weapon Drops

  • Lanceram (Gustave/Verso) — drops from the Lancelier encounter after the rest point
  • Lighterim (Lune) — drops from the first Abbest enemy killed

sections.title: Flying Waters
sections.content:
Flying Waters (Level 8) is a waterfall-filled area with multiple branching paths. This is where the game opens up significantly with new systems and side content.

Story Progression

  • Navigate through the south entrance following the main waterfalls
  • Defeat Goblu (Level 8 Required Boss) to progress the story
  • After completion: weapon upgrades, Colour of Lumina, and Tint upgrades all become available

Important Side Content

  • Demineur Quest: Help this Nevron with their request. Reward is Deminerim (Lune) — a Lightning weapon that can reduce Electrify's AP cost to zero
  • Bourgeon (Level 8 Optional Boss): Defeat this boss now — it's required for a quest later in the game. The Bourgeon drops Abysseram (Gustave/Verso)
  • The Curator in The Manor (Level 8 Optional): A challenging optional boss in the manor building
  • Chromatic Troubadour (Level 8 Optional): Drops Troubadim (Lune)

Weapon Drops

  • Brulerum (Maelle) — first Bruler enemy killed
  • Cruleram (Gustave/Verso) — first Cruler enemy killed

sections.title: Ancient Sanctuary
sections.content:
The Ancient Sanctuary (Level 12) is a maze-like dungeon with hidden passages and crouching paths. Take your time exploring every corner for valuable rewards.

Main Objective

  • Navigate the Sanctuary Maze — look for crouching-height passages in rock walls
  • Defeat Ultimate Sakapatate (Level 12 Required Boss) — a multi-phase fight testing your skill rotation mastery
  • Fight the Ancient Sanctuary Mime (Level 12 Optional) for cosmetics

Key Weapon: Trebuchim

This is one of Lune's best weapons for the mid-game. Find the Catapult and Ranger Sakapatates in the clearing accessed by crouching through rocks near the Sanctuary Maze rest point. Defeating them drops Trebuchim, which generates random Stains on Free Aim shots — enabling powerful Elemental Genesis combos.

Additional Finds

  • Sakaram (Gustave/Verso) — drops from the Robust Sakapatate story enemy
  • The Small Bourgeon side area becomes accessible — Grown Bourgeon (Level 8 Optional Boss) awaits inside

After completing the Sanctuary, you'll continue toward Gestral Village where the party expands significantly.

sections.title: Gestral Village
sections.content:
Gestral Village (Level 15) serves as Act 1's major hub area with extensive side content, shops, and the recruitment of Sciel as a party member.

Story Bosses

  • Bertrand Big Hands, Dominique Tiny Feet, Matthieu The Colossus — Required fights as part of the village storyline
  • Sciel — Boss fight that leads to her joining your party permanently

Gestral Arena

The Hidden Gestral Arena offers solo-fight challenges against the same bosses (Bertrand, Dominique, Julien Tiny Head, Matthieu). Complete the final Arena fight as Maelle to receive Medalum — her best early-game weapon that starts her in Virtuose Stance every battle.

Side Quests & Activities

  • Karatom Quest: NPC questline in the village
  • Ono-Puncho Challenge: Combat mini-game with rewards
  • Help Alexsoundro: Assist this NPC for unique items
  • Gestral Beach: Find swimsuit cosmetics for your party
  • Red Woods Fountain: Interact for lore and items

Weapon Shops

  • Demonam (Gustave/Verso) — buy from Gestral Merchant after defeating them
  • Sekarum (Maelle) — buy from Eesda after winning a fight
  • Betelim (Lune) — inside the hut behind the Paint Spike (requires Paint Break)

sections.title: Esquie's Nest
sections.content:
Esquie's Nest (Level 17) is a shorter dungeon that rewards you with one of the game's most impactful quality-of-life upgrades — the Esquie mount for fast overworld travel.

Main Objectives

  • Navigate the nest area fighting local enemies
  • Defeat the Esquie's Nest Mime (Level 17 Optional) for cosmetics
  • Defeat Francois (Level 17 Required Boss) to complete the area

Esquie Mount Reward

After leaving Esquie's Nest, you unlock the ability to ride Esquie on the overworld. This dramatically speeds up travel across The Continent and makes revisiting earlier areas for missed collectibles much more practical. Esquie can also access certain terrain that was previously impassable on foot.

Lost Gestrals

With Esquie available, you can now efficiently search for Lost Gestrals scattered across explored areas. Return them to Camp for rewards including Pictos and crafting materials. Several Lost Gestrals are hidden in locations only reachable with Esquie's mobility.

sections.title: Stone Wave Cliffs
sections.content:
Stone Wave Cliffs (Level 19) is Act 1's final and most complex dungeon, featuring verticality, destroyed airships, and multiple entrance paths.

Story Bosses

  • Lampmaster (Level 19 Required) — guards the main progression path
  • White-Haired Man (Level 19 Required) — Act 1's climactic boss fight. A significant difficulty spike requiring mastery of parry timing.

Swimming Unlock

Completing Stone Wave Cliffs grants the ability to swim, opening water-blocked paths throughout the entire game world. Immediately revisit earlier areas for previously inaccessible chests, weapons, and bosses.

Optional Content

  • Hexga Quest: Complete this side quest within the cliffs
  • Chromatic Hexga — found in Stone Wave Cliffs Cave (Level 45, return much later)
  • Bourgeon (Level 19 Optional) — another Bourgeon variant in this area
  • Rocher (Level 19 Optional) — hidden boss worth finding for XP

Weapons in This Area

  • Delaram (Gustave/Verso) — inside Paint Cage above the Hexga, near Expedition 78 entry
  • Coralim (Lune) — top of ruined building, accessible via rope climb and gap jump
  • Duenum (Maelle) — shoot all locks on the Paint Cage in the farm area
  • Chation (Sciel) — drops from Greatsword Cultist + Reaper Cultist duo near the bridge

sections.title: Side Content & Collectibles
sections.content:
Act 1 contains numerous collectibles and side activities. Here's a comprehensive checklist of what to gather before moving to Act 2.

Overworld Bosses (After Esquie)

  • Chromatic Bruler (Level 19) — North of Gestral Village on The Continent
  • Bourgeon (Level 20) — near The Meadows on the overworld

Collectible Categories

TypeAct 1 CountNotes
Journal Entries~15Check behind environmental objects, requires Old Key from Prologue
Music Records~8Found in chests and from NPCs
Lost Gestrals~6Return to Camp for rewards
Tints~5Unlocked after Flying Waters upgrades
Pictos~10From bosses, chests, and quests

Before Leaving Act 1

  • Ensure you've defeated the Flying Waters Bourgeon (needed for later quest)
  • Complete Gestral Arena as Maelle for Medalum weapon
  • Collect all weapons from enemy drops in each area
  • Check Paint Cages — some require abilities gained later (mark their locations)
  • Ride Esquie to all DANGER zone entrances to note their recommended levels for later

Note that all Act 1 areas remain accessible throughout the entire game. Nothing is permanently locked behind story progression.
